hero.subDefault: A 14-hour curriculum for the new generation of AI-native creators. Foundations to image, video, content, and monetization — without the fluff. Five modules, twenty lessons, designed to compound.

outcomes.heading: By the end, you will:
outcomes.subheading: Three concrete outcomes — not vague promises.

items.title: Ship a mini-film.
items.body: From script to anchor frames to multishot animation. By the end of module 3, you have a finished film.

items.title: Build a recognizable style.
items.body: Composition, references, palettes. Students leave with a visual signature, not a prompt cheat-sheet.

items.title: Turn skill into income.
items.body: Productize, sell, scale. Module 5 covers offers, pricing, and the launch playbook that actually works.

curriculum.heading: What you'll learn over 14 hours

instructor.heading: Meet your instructor
instructor.bioDefault: An AI-native filmmaker, designer, and educator. Built award-winning short films using only AI tools, taught hundreds of students across Central Asia, and shipped commercial work for brands like Uzum, Humo, and Click. This curriculum is the playbook used to do it.

items.q: Do I need any AI experience to start?
items.a: No. The first module assumes zero background — you'll be generating images by lesson 3.
3–5 hours. The full curriculum is ~14 hours; most students finish in 4–6 weeks.

items.q: Can I follow on my phone?
items.a: Yes. The video player and AI tutor are mobile-first. Lessons stream in adaptive HD.

items.q: What if I get stuck on a lesson?
items.a: Every lesson has the AI Study Assistant — it's trained on the transcript and can explain, summarize, or quiz you.
Module-level certificates of completion will roll out in the next update.

items.q: Is the content in English, Russian, or Uzbek?
items.a: Lessons are taught in English with Russian and Uzbek subtitles. UI is fully translated.
No — videos stream from secure storage to protect creator IP. Notes and transcripts are downloadable.
Signup is free. There's nothing to cancel until our premium tier launches.

ai.title: AI Study Assistant
ai.desc: Customize the assistant's tone, scope, and the knowledge base it can draw from across all courses.
ai.promptPh: You are a friendly study assistant for {course_title}. Answer in the student's chosen language. Use the lesson context when helpful: {transcript}. Be concise, encouraging, and ask follow-up questions when appropriate.
ai.promptTip: Tip: include lines like "Refuse to discuss topics unrelated to this course" to keep the tutor on-topic.
ai.kbDesc: Upload PDFs, Word docs, or text files. They're parsed, chunked, and indexed for semantic search — the assistant fetches the most relevant passages per student question, regardless of total library size.

protection.desc: Layered defenses against screen recording on lesson playback. Admin pages are unaffected.

protection.noteBody: Browsers cannot fully prevent screen recording. These layers make it harder and let you trace any leak via the watermark.

deploy.title: Deploy
deploy.subtitle: Ship your platform to your own infrastructure.
deploy.step1Desc: In Lovable, open the GitHub menu (top right) → "Connect to GitHub" → authorize and create the repository. Every Lovable change syncs in both directions.
deploy.step2Desc: Auth, database, file storage, and edge functions remain managed. Only the React frontend deploys to your VPS or static host. Your env vars:
deploy.scalingDesc: Direct upload works for <200 MB lessons. For HD video at scale (500+ students), use Bunny Stream (~$1/month per 100 GB delivered, global CDN, automatic HLS encoding) or Mux. In the lesson editor, switch the video source to Embed → Bunny / Mux and paste your video ID. The player auto-uses HLS adaptive bitrate via hls.js.
